1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""
3	Universe builder utilities.
4	
5	Features
6	- Fetch current S&P 500 / S&P 100 / S&P 1000 / NASDAQ‑100 constituents (via Wikipedia).
7	- Save date‑stamped snapshots to a folder so you can use "as_of" universes later.
8	- Load the latest snapshot on or before an as‑of date.
9	- Optionally rank a base universe by live market cap (yfinance) and emit Top‑N.
10	
11	Notes
12	- Historical membership backfills require stored snapshots; this script can't reconstruct
13	  exact past membership. Schedule it monthly/quarterly to build your own history.
14	- Network access is required at runtime for fetching Wikipedia pages or market caps.
15	"""
16	
17	import argparse
18	import datetime as dt
19	import os
20	from typing import List, Optional
21	
22	import pandas as pd
23	import requests
24	
25	
26	WIKI_PAGES = {
27	    "sp500": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies",
28	    "sp100": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%26P_100",
29	    "sp1000": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/S%26P_1000",
30	    "nasdaq100": "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nasdaq-100",
31	}
32	
33	NASDAQ_ALL_URL = "https://old.nasdaqtrader.com/dynamic/SymDir/nasdaqlisted.txt"
34	
35	
36	def _clean_symbol(sym: str) -> str:
37	    # Keep raw ticker; some sources include NASDAQ: prefixes or class suffixes
38	    s = str(sym).strip().upper()
39	    s = s.replace("\xa0", " ")
40	    return s.split()[0]
41	
42	
43	def fetch_nasdaq_all(url: str = NASDAQ_ALL_URL) -> List[str]:
44	    """Return the full NASDAQ listing (excludes test issues) from the Nasdaq Trader feed."""
45	    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=30)
46	    resp.raise_for_status()
47	    tickers: List[str] = []
48	    for line in resp.text.splitlines():
49	        line = line.strip()
50	        if not line or line.startswith("Symbol|") or line.startswith("File Creation Time"):
51	            continue
52	        parts = line.split("|")
53	        if not parts:
54	            continue
55	        sym = _clean_symbol(parts[0])
56	        if not sym or sym == "Symbol":
57	            continue
58	        # Column order: Symbol|Security Name|Market Category|Test Issue|...
59	        test_issue = parts[3].strip().upper() if len(parts) > 3 else "N"
60	        if test_issue == "Y":
61	            continue
62	        tickers.append(sym.replace(".", "-"))
63	    # Preserve order but drop duplicates
64	    seen = set()
65	    unique = []
66	    for t in tickers:
67	        if t not in seen:
68	            seen.add(t)
69	            unique.append(t)
70	    return unique
71	
72	
73	def fetch_index(index: str) -> List[str]:
74	    index = index.lower()
75	    if index in {"nasdaq_all", "nasdaq"}:
76	        return fetch_nasdaq_all()
77	    if index not in WIKI_PAGES:
78	        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported index: {index}")
79	    url = WIKI_PAGES[index]
80	    tables = pd.read_html(url)
81	    # Heuristics per page
82	    tickers: List[str] = []
83	    for tab in tables:
84	        for col in ("Symbol", "Ticker", "Company Symbol", "Ticker symbol"):
85	            if col in tab.columns:
86	                tickers = [_clean_symbol(x) for x in tab[col].tolist()]
87	                break
88	        if tickers:
89	            break
90	    if not tickers:
91	        # NASDAQ-100 sometimes lists "Ticker" column in the second table
92	        for tab in tables:
93	            if isinstance(tab.columns, pd.MultiIndex):
94	                continue
95	            if any("Ticker" in str(c) for c in tab.columns):
96	                c0 = [c for c in tab.columns if "Ticker" in str(c)][0]
97	                tickers = [_clean_symbol(x) for x in tab[c0].tolist()]
98	                break
99	    if not tickers:
100	        raise RuntimeError(f"Failed to parse tickers from {url}")
101	    # Basic cleanups for Yahoo symbols
102	    return [t.replace(".", "-") for t in tickers if t and t != "nan"]
103	
104	
105	def save_snapshot(tickers: List[str], out_dir: str, index: str, when: Optional[dt.date] = None) -> str:
106	    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
107	    d = when or dt.date.today()
108	    path = os.path.join(out_dir, f"{d.isoformat()}_{index}.txt")
109	    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
110	        for t in tickers:
111	            f.write(t + "\n")
112	    return path
113	
114	
115	def load_as_of(out_dir: str, index: str, as_of: dt.date) -> List[str]:
116	    if not os.path.isdir(out_dir):
117	        raise FileNotFoundError(out_dir)
118	    files = [fn for fn in os.listdir(out_dir) if fn.endswith(f"_{index}.txt")]
119	    candidates = []
120	    for fn in files:
121	        try:
122	            d = dt.date.fromisoformat(fn.split("_")[0])
123	            if d <= as_of:
124	                candidates.append((d, fn))
125	        except Exception:
126	            continue
127	    if not candidates:
128	        raise FileNotFoundError(f"No snapshots for {index} on/before {as_of}")
129	    d, fn = sorted(candidates, key=lambda x: x[0])[-1]
130	    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, fn), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
131	        return [ln.strip() for ln in f if ln.strip() and not ln.startswith("#")]
132	
133	
134	def top_n_by_market_cap(base: List[str], n: int) -> List[str]:
135	    import yfinance as yf  # runtime dependency
136	
137	    caps = []
138	    for t in base:
139	        try:
140	            info = yf.Ticker(t).fast_info  # faster path
141	            mc = getattr(info, "market_cap", None)
142	            if mc is None:
143	                # fallback to .info (slower)
144	                mc = yf.Ticker(t).info.get("marketCap")
145	            if mc:
146	                caps.append((t, float(mc)))
147	        except Exception:
148	            continue
149	    caps.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
150	    return [t for t, _ in caps[:n]]
151	
152	
153	def main() -> None:
154	    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Build and snapshot index universes")
155	    p.add_argument(
156	        "--index",
157	        type=str,
158	        choices=["sp500", "sp100", "sp1000", "nasdaq100", "nasdaq_all"],
159	        help="Index to fetch",
160	    )
161	    p.add_argument("--snapshot_dir", type=str, default="universes", help="Directory to save snapshots")
162	    p.add_argument("--refresh", action="store_true", help="Fetch current list and save snapshot")
163	    p.add_argument("--as_of", type=str, default=None, help="Return the latest snapshot on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)")
164	    p.add_argument("--out_file", type=str, default=None, help="Optional path to write the resulting tickers list")
165	    p.add_argument("--top_n", type=int, default=None, help="If set, return the top N by market cap from the result")
166	    args = p.parse_args()
167	
168	    result: List[str]
169	    if args.refresh:
170	        tickers = fetch_index(args.index)
171	        path = save_snapshot(tickers, args.snapshot_dir, args.index)
172	        print(f"Saved snapshot: {path} ({len(tickers)} tickers)")
173	        result = tickers
174	    elif args.as_of:
175	        as_of = dt.date.fromisoformat(args.as_of)
176	        result = load_as_of(args.snapshot_dir, args.index, as_of)
177	        print(f"Loaded snapshot for {args.index} as of {args.as_of}: {len(result)} tickers")
178	    else:
179	        # On-demand current pull without saving
180	        result = fetch_index(args.index)
181	        print(f"Fetched current {args.index}: {len(result)} tickers")
182	
183	    if args.top_n:
184	        result = top_n_by_market_cap(result, int(args.top_n))
185	        print(f"Top {len(result)} by market cap")
186	
187	    if args.out_file:
188	        with open(args.out_file, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
189	            for t in result:
190	                f.write(t + "\n")
191	        print(f"Wrote {len(result)} to {args.out_file}")
192	    else:
193	        # print to stdout
194	        for t in result:
195	            print(t)
196	
197	
198	if __name__ == "__main__":
199	    main()
200
